description: Image Description: The image depicts a cozy living room with wooden flooring. Dominating the left side is a large, ornate wooden armoire with decorative greenery and draped fabric on top. In the center of the back wall, there is a small wooden fireplace mantel with a framed picture above it. To the right, a small wooden side table holds a lamp, and a wall-mounted sconce provides additional lighting. A large mirror is mounted on the right wall above a plush brown sofa adorned with decorative pillows
